classes.label: Open — reuse with attribution
classes.statement: Reuse, adaptation and redistribution of this page are permitted, with attribution to the page and to the sources it lists.

classes.label: Cite only — quote and cite, do not republish
classes.statement: Quotation and citation of this page with attribution are permitted; wholesale copying, adaptation or redistribution of the page are not permitted by this statement.

classes.label: Internal — reuse inside this wiki only
classes.statement: Reuse of this page is permitted inside this wiki and in the owner's and the agent's own work only; no external redistribution is permitted by this statement.

classes.label: Closed — reading in place only
classes.statement: This page may be read in place; this statement permits no copying, adaptation or redistribution of it.

default_basis: This public edition's seed corpus is fictional demonstration material published openly alongside the edition's software (MIT, see LICENSE). Absent a per-page statement, a page is therefore read as open with attribution. An installation that replaces the seed corpus with its own material must restate this default in this file before relying on it — the default describes the seed corpus, not any corpus an installer later compiles.
vocabulary: Per-page FAIR reuse classes (Marathon R6 lane BB; pattern: Wilkinson et al. 2016, CC BY 4.0 — the FAIR Reusable principle narrowed to a per-page reuse statement; vocabulary and statements are this edition's own words)
